keyPhrases.text: The cast is talented and able. They have style and grace and excellent voices
pasteurized version of what was originally raw milk
we are asked to accept this instead of what was intended

reasoning: While acknowledging the cast's talent, the review is predominantly critical of the direction and overall execution. The critic finds the production misses the essence of the original work, describing it as 'pasteurized' and 'overthought.' The negative assessment outweighs the limited praise.
